page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s3.large is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. This server type features 4 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 4 physical cores, operating with 1.0 thread per core. It is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per vCPU.

The instance does not include local storage or bundled GPUs, meaning all storage requirements must be met through external block storage volumes. Additionally, it does not provide complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With its dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s3.large offers a compute-focused resource profile. This configuration is suitable for workloads requiring dedicated processing power without massive memory footprints, such as lightweight web serving, application servers, and basic computational tasks.
